Verdict

The screen does not match the design, and this is not a small fix. The skeleton rendering technique itself differs, two circular gauges are missing, the bottom metrics panel is missing, and its underlying data is computed nowhere in the code. This needs a real plan and an operator scope decision, not a targeted patch.

How this conclusion was reached

Step 1 — Form Coach crash

Fixed a real but cosmetically unrelated issue (ML Kit model accurate→base). The crash turned out to live in a separate Google Play Services process, not app code — see the separate crash report.

Step 2 — "why is there no skeleton?"

Code review showed the dark silhouette and glowing skeleton are intended behavior, and partial glow is a low tracking-confidence artifact. Accurate, but incomplete.

Step 3 — "does this match the design?"

The operator sent the exact design export and a Figma prototype screenshot next to the live app. Code comparison confirmed: no technique-score circle exists at all, the rep counter is a small badge not a circle, and the bottom four-metric panel does not exist.

Step 4 — video + exact design archive

The operator sent a 31-second screen recording and the exact design zip (Mobile app design (4).zip). Frame-by-frame comparison (63 frames) showed the skeleton-drawing technique itself differs — the design uses an organic green glow that contours the body; the app draws rigid white polygons. A code search confirmed Tempo/Amplitude/Symmetry/Pause data exists nowhere — not a forgotten widget, a missing pipeline.

Design vs. app

The exact design source (update within this same investigation)

The operator supplied the current design zip (Mobile app design (4).zip) and stated directly that this exact source must be checked every time, not relied on from memory or an older copy (full_handoff_v1, which this session had been citing). Copied into the repo at core/design/reference/fitness_hud_v1/; a standing memory was saved so this stops recurring across sessions.

Inside it is not just flattened images but a literal executable mockup (Fitness Form Coach Phone.dc.html) with exact values: 158×158px circles, a skeleton spec of thin 3.4px lines (not thick polygons, as the app draws), double drop-shadow glow in green/red, joint circles r=4–4.5px. There is no filled dark body silhouette anywhere in the design itself — that is the app's own addition, not a design requirement. The README states directly: "High-fidelity... reproduce pixel-perfectly" — this is a final mockup, not a sketch.

Next steps

The operator chose the scope: full design fidelity. Further work needs a real plan and a GO, not a targeted patch:

  1. Replace the thick polygon body with a thin line skeleton (3.4px, drop-shadow glow) per the exact reference in Fitness Form Coach Phone.dc.html.
  2. Add the two circular gauges (Reps, Technique) in the glass HUD style, 158×158px.
  3. Design and implement computation for the four new metrics (Tempo, Amplitude, Symmetry, Pause) — this pipeline does not exist today.
  4. Add the "Счётчики тренера" bottom panel and colour states (green/red) across the UI, including the second amber cue chip on a fault.

A concrete gate-by-gate plan follows in a separate message. No further "done" claim on this screen without a separate GO.

Full evidence chain, code line references and design quotes: core/DECISION_LOG.md in the project repository (entries 655c4c6 through f0100d0).
